UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Root identity document for all account sub-collections. Access is strictly controlled to the authenticated owner (UID match).

WalletAsset.title: Wallet Asset
WalletAsset.description: Cryptographic vault document. Owners have full read/write access to their own assets sub-collection.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Private financial ledger for the authenticated user. Owners have full read and create access.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user document. Authorizes owner-only access based on path userId matching auth.uid.

/users/{userId}/assets/{assetId}.description: Sub-collection document. Access restricted to the parent userId matching auth.uid.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{txId}.description: Financial ledger sub-collection. Access restricted to the parent userId matching auth.uid.
